text:
ben_sales: Quick handoff — AetherHealth just signed annual Dedicated (reserved GPUs). Passing to CS for onboarding + Eng/Support for SSO + private VPC kickoff. High level: HIPAA scope, SSO with SAML, want private VPC & KMS, target go-live in ~6 weeks.

tia_csm: Thanks @ben_sales — I’ll own onboarding. Tagging owners: @sarah_onboard for provisioning/enablement, @alex_eng for SSO connector + private deploy validation, @sam_support for runbook/support escalation.

sarah_onboard: Onboarding notes: customer prefers Tue/Thu 11am PT for enablement calls. Primary contacts: lena@aetherhealth.com (IT admin), ravi@aetherhealth.com (product). Need provisioning invite & service account by Mon.

alex_eng: Acknowledged. Two immediate eng tasks: 1) Confirm SAML attribute mapping with customer (nameID, email, groups). 2) Validate private VPC network egress rules. Can someone drop the SAML metadata and network CIDR?

sam_support: Will create support ticket and attach runbook draft. Proposing labels: aether-sso, private-vpc, hipaa. ETA to draft runbook: 48h.

ben_sales: SAML metadata: https://aetherhealth.com/saml/metadata.xml — they use Okta. Network CIDR for their firewall team: 10.41.0.0/22. They also asked about logging retention for HIPAA (90d).

alex_eng: Thanks — I’ll spin up a staging private deploy to validate KV store + quantization profiles this week. Need access to their test cert (lena said she can share via secure link). Also confirm we can meet 99.9% latency SLO for their flows (mainly chat + embeddings).

tia_csm: Action items (owners):
- Onboarding kickoff call + agenda (sarah_onboard)
- Create support ticket + runbook (sam_support)
- Eng validation: SSO mapping + staging deploy (alex_eng)
- Compliance note: HIPAA controls + logging retention (tia_csm)
Please update tickets with owners & ETA.

sarah_onboard: Scheduling kickoff: Tentative Wed 2026-05-13 11am PT. Sending calendar invite to their IT & product. Will include brief checklist: API keys, IP allowlist, service account, test data instructions.

sam_support: Support ticket created: #CS-7892. Initial comment with labels and owner tags. Linking runbook draft: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/aether-sso-dedicated (private).

alex_eng: I opened ENG issue: RED-ENG-4123. Subtasks: obtain cert, run deploy in staging, SAML attribute verification. Assigning to me + infra oncall. Target: staging validation by 2026-05-18.

tia_csm: Renewal risk notes: customer is enterprise with contractual SLA expectation. Main risk if we delay SSO or private deploy >4 weeks — they may request credit/penalty. Flagging as medium-high. Keep sales looped.

ben_sales: Noted. I’ll keep account exec in the loop and confirm contractual milestones. Also they want a short enablement doc for their engineers; @sarah_onboard can you create a 1-pager?

sarah_onboard: Yep — will draft 1-pager and share in thread before kickoff.

ops-bot: Provisioning job for aether-dedicated-staging started by sarah_onboard at 1768579400. Status: running.

alex_eng: Quick ask — please capture a minimal prompt set for quality monitoring after go-live. I’ll hook it into Redwood Optimize to baseline model choices.

tia_csm: Will collect initial prompt set from product contact (ravi). Also capture acceptance criteria for go/no-go.

ben_sales: Thanks everyone — summary: owners assigned, tickets created (CS-7892, RED-ENG-4123), kickoff Wed 2026-05-13 11am PT. If blockers surface, ping #eng-oncall and @alex_eng. :thumbsup:
